results.name: Mar Saba Monastery  -RAWscan
results.description:
The Holy Lavra of Saint Sabbas the Sanctified, known in Arabic as Mar Saba  is an Eastern Orthodox Christian monastery overlooking the Kidron Valley at a point halfway between the Old City of Jerusalem and the Dead Sea, within the Bethlehem Governorate of the West Bank.
The traditional date for the founding of the monastery by Sabbas the Sanctified of Mutalaska, Cappadocia is the year 483. Today, the complex houses around 20 monks. It is considered to be one of the oldest inhabited monasteries in the world, and still maintains many of its ancient traditions. One in particular is the restriction on women entering the main compound. The only building that women can enter is the Women's Tower, near the main entrance.
Wikipedia

Ladislav Šichman

Ladislav Šichman is the Slovak sculptor focused on the small sculpture, sculptures of miniatures, reliefs, jewellery, designs of coins, medals and monumental sculpture as well. His work has been focused on women and motherhood bearing traces of a strong emotional bias and the attempts to performed reality in the most realistic way. Attractive and publicly admired are Shichman's sculptural miniatures cast in the tin or even in silver. His creative effort has always been related to pedagogical activities.

This model was made from 175 pictures taken with a Nikon D7000. No sculpting was made.

results.name: Ghirlandaio's 'Portrait of a Young Woman'
results.description:
Benedetto Ghirlandaio's 'Portrait of a Young Woman,' 15th C CE, now in the collection of the Minneapolis Institute of Art.

From [artsmia.org](www.artsmia.org):

*'Benedetto was the youngest of the Ghirlandaio brothers, an established family workshop in late Quattrocento Florence. In the years 1486-1493 he sought new opportunities in France. His only documented work is a Nativity in the church of Aigueperse (Auvergne), where the painter worked for the governor Gilbert de Bourbon-Montpensier and his wife Chiara Gonzaga, daughter of Marquis Federico of Mantua. This portrait aligns so perfectly with the stylistic characteristics of the signed painting that its attribution to Benedetto cannot be doubted. There is no clue, however, as to the identity of the sitter...'*

More [here](https://collections.artsmia.org/art/1681/portrait-of-a-young-woman-benedetto-ghirlandaio)

More on 'cradling' for paintings on wood panels [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cradling_(paintings))

results.name: Woman Life Freedom - Grafitti
results.description: A political grafitti in SF, Mission. It refers to the [Woman Life Freedom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Woman,_Life,_Freedom) movement and the words written on the garage doors are the lyrix to the Grammy awarded song Baraye. In form the writing combines traditional persian caligraphy with the visual style of grafitti and tagging, resulting in an interesting and unique look.
